description: This file defines a utility class ByteUtil for byte array manipulations, conversions, and pattern matching, used within the RomRaider project.

classes.name: ByteUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for byte and array conversions, pattern matching, and byte array operations.

methods.name: asUnsignedInt
methods.description: Converts a byte or byte array to an unsigned integer.

methods.name: asSignedInt
methods.description: Converts a byte array to a signed integer.

methods.name: asByte
methods.description: Converts an integer to a byte.

methods.name: asFloat
methods.description: Converts a subset of a byte array to a float value.

methods.name: asInt
methods.description: Converts a byte to an integer.

methods.name: matchOnes
methods.description: Checks if specific bits are set in a byte.

methods.name: matchZeroes
methods.description: Checks if specific bits are zero in a byte.

methods.name: byteListToBytes
methods.description: Copies a List<Byte> into a byte array.

methods.name: indexOfBytes
methods.description: Finds the index of a pattern byte array within another byte array.

methods.name: computeFailure
methods.description: Computes the failure function for pattern matching (KMP algorithm).
